# graviteeam_reporter (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM Reporter (file, jdbc, kafka, mongodb)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_reporter" "example" {
  domain_id = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  name      = "File Audit Reporter"
  type      = "reporter-am-file"
  enabled   = true
  inherited = false
  configuration = jsonencode({
    filename = "audit-events.log"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration` (String) JSON configuration for the reporter plugin
- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain
- `name` (String) The name of the reporter
- `type` (String) The reporter plugin type (e.g. reporter-am-file, mongodb)

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the reporter is enabled
- `inherited` (Boolean) Whether the reporter inherits its configuration

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the reporter
